annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: just swaps him for five people

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: on a track that isn't live, you trust whoever's at the switch

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Five people think they're out of harm's way

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Those five probably feel perfectly safe
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because an empty maintenance train isn't supposed to be on their stretch
